{"design":"DRAFT PLAN (2026-11-14, not yet approved by Mark). Goal: a mimid-hosted room with a Haven user invited (IETF 127 follow-up).

Hub side already exists: Hub::key_material relays foreign targets via peers (hub/key_material.rs ~L162); update.rs sends Welcomes to added users' domains (.6.10); /v1/keyMaterial for a mimid-hosted room reaches the hub (http.rs key_material). Missing: creating the room.

Who builds the group: the client (draft: "The client first creates the MLS group"; AGENTS.md: only mimid-agent holds MLS keys; server never decrypts). For the test, seeded users' keys live in mimid-seed's state dir (<name>/mls.sqlite).

Steps (size):
1. jmap/session.rs: mimi account capability with userUri, roomIdPrefix, hubSender (Hub::hub_sender), cipherSuites. Oracle: hand-written Session JSON; hubSender decodes to Hub::hub_sender(). (S, 1/2 day)
2. store/rooms.rs + hub/mod.rs: atomic create (room row + creator follower_member + Chat via ensure_chat). Oracle: rows exist after success; none after a failing hub check. (S-M, 1 day)
3. jmap/methods/room_create.rs: decode args, room_uri from room_metadata, draft rules 2/4/5/6 the hub doesn't check, map HubError to invalidArguments, ChangeBus, return {accountId, roomId, chatId}. Tests per rule, accountNotFound, 401, Chat/get shows roomId; mimi-mls bytes now, mls-rs as independent oracle later. (M, 1.5-2 days)
4. mimi-mls: export an epoch-0 GroupInfo (no Member::group_info today), checked by Observer::from_group_info. (S, 1/2 day)
5. tools/interop/seed: --issue-token (Store::issue_token). Live check: token authenticates, Session 200. (S, 1/2 day)
6. tools/interop/chat --mimid mode: identity from seed state + --token; /create builds the group (external sender = hubSender; franking_agent, Safe AAD requiring frank_aad, roles_list, base_room_policy, participant_list=[me], room_metadata) and calls Room/create; /invite, update, submitMessage over PeerClient to mimid's own hub, franked; drop JSON-lane calls (hub /notify carries Welcome/Commit to Haven); inbound via JMAP Chat/get + Message/query/get (bodies are base64url FanoutMessages). (M-L, 2-3 days)
7. acceptance-style live script. (1/2-1 day)
Total ~6-9 working days.

Can wait: KeyPackage/set (.12.3), KeyMaterial/fetch (.12.5), Room/update (.12.6), Room/send (.12.7), GroupInfo/fetch (.12.8), EventSource (.11.4), full mls-rs failure suite, sideband (.47).

Questions for Mark:
Q1 JMAP Room/create (bearer auth) as the creation path, not a .47 sideband endpoint?
Q2 Room ID: decision .12.14 (hub generates room and group IDs) vs draft rules 5/6 (client chooses room_uri; 16-octet group ID). mimid-chat assumes group ID = room URI (chat.rs ~L662); Haven may too. Enforce rule 6 now or defer?
Q3 Rule 2 "leaf key bound to the account": accept mimid-seed's client rows as the binding until KeyPackage/set?
Q4 Types: bump crate-jmap pin (b8b6f251) to one with crate-jmap-chat-mimi-types, or parse locally and leave types to .12.2?
Q5 For the test, may mimid-chat speak the wire lane to mimid's own hub with From: mimid.reviewcommit.com until .12.5-.12.7 exist?
Q6 Franking: hub requires frank_aad in Safe AAD (test create_room_requires_frank_aad_in_safe_aad); Haven's client must add frank_aad for erin's messages. Confirm with Jason.
Also for Haven: erin's KeyPackages must list in leaf app_components every component the room lists (0x0021, 0x0022, 0x0025, 0x0027, plus Safe AAD frank_aad 0x0020)."}
